name: Attribute-aware Mixed-Precision Optimizer States for Gaussian Splatting
status: independent lane; does not modify CGT/DPS0/IGF/RetireGS/ClockGS/Sparse-tail K50-B1 verdicts
core_hypothesis: Geometry-sensitive attributes (means/scales/quats/opacity) require high optimizer-state precision; high-dimensional appearance states (SH0/SH-rest) may tolerate lower storage precision. FP32 compute + BF16 moment storage may reduce optimizer HBM traffic enough to accelerate a fused training pipeline without materially changing reconstruction quality.
scope: STATE PRECISION ONLY. Excludes: sparse/sparse-selective Adam, deferred Adam, skip-invisible update, changed LR/beta/epsilon, changed loss, changed renderer, changed gradient, changed densification, FP8/INT8, stochastic rounding (objective section 27).
hardware_cohort: MX A100 (authoritative). Local host = RTX 5070 Laptop 8GB -> ALL local timing non-authoritative; numerics marked shared_gpu_numerics_only=true / performance_evidence_valid=false.
strong_baseline: Faster-GS fused (FasterGSFused @ ae665af, NeRFICG @ e458ac6), A100/EPIC-05. Not vanilla Adam.

candidate_grid.C0: all m/v FP32 (reference, must match baseline)
candidate_grid.C4: ALL m/v BF16 (exploratory ceiling, diagnostic only)

fail_closed_gates: P0 headroom: f_opt<0.20 on ALL scenes -> DROP_INSUFFICIENT_OPTIMIZER_HEADROOM
P1 numerics: C1 fails eligibility -> DROP_STATE_PRECISION_NUMERICS
P1 cross-scene: any scene fails -> DROP
P3A quality: dPSNR>=-0.10 & dSSIM>=-0.002 & dLPIPS<=+0.005 else DROP_CONVERGENCE_FIDELITY
P3A E2E: geomean<1.05x -> DROP_E2E_HEADROOM; >=1.08x promote; >=1.15x strong
execution_order: P0 baseline audit+profile -> headroom gate -> traffic oracle -> P1 shadow oracle -> cross-scene numerics -> P2 microbench -> freeze -> lifecycle -> P3A -> P3B -> multi-scene
immediate_scope: P0 + P1 only. No substantial CUDA engineering before both pass. Fail-closed: stop and return evidence if any gate blocks. No rescue variant inside AMPS0.
numerical_boundary: AMPS0 is NOT mathematically exact Adam once a state is stored in BF16. Forbidden: exact equivalence / identical trajectory / lossless / exact gradient. Allowed: mixed-precision optimizer-state storage; FP32 update arithmetic with reduced-precision moment storage; quality-preserving within measured benchmark tolerance.
notes: Prior-art audit (AMPS0_PRIOR_ART_AUDIT.md) classifies primary mechanism as NO_DIRECT_GS_MATCH_FOUND but with PARTIAL_OVERLAP from generic 8-bit optimizers and GS parameter compression. Fresh literature audit mandatory before any paper claim.
